subject: Round-2 revision done: 3 blocking applied, fixcheck exit 0
body: Verified all round-2 findings and the flagged citations against live sources (Orca 1.4.245 help and recovery guide, workflow skill, inventories), then revised the spec in 4 hunks: R1.3 now has the coordinator rename the failed attempt's return-contract.yaml (and, without resume, its output location) before worker-start --retry-of, since a retry reuses the Task's brief (WC-6, 2.3, section 3 intro); R2.1 fixes AC-1.2 (load exempt, brief per 2.3, no --output for workflow); R2.2 lists the P0 differences for steps 1, 3 and 4 in AC-0.4; R2.5's citation is fixed to CAPS:59-60 inside the R1.3 rewrite. Minor R2.3, R2.4 and C13 are rejected for this cycle because fixcheck refuses hunks owned only by minor ids (diffgate.py:915-918); C7 needs no change; fixcheck --dry-run exits 0 (62054 to 63717 bytes) and the placeholder scan is clean. Left for the coordinator: the binding fixcheck and review 3, the suggested later wording for R2.3/R2.4, and WC-6's rename step has no acceptance check yet.
